t: This is Garden Lodge, a detached house on Logan Place in Kensington. It was completed in 1909 for the painter Cecil Rea and his wife, the sculptor Constance Halford. It is best known as the last home of Freddie Mercury, the singer and pianist who fronted Queen. He is regarded as one of the greatest voices in rock, with a four-octave range. Mary Austin, his partner and later his personal assistant, lived here too. She remained his closest friend until his death in 1991, and became his principal heir.
